title: Copy with the pharmacist, original with the physician
rule_summary: An authorized pharmacist must maintain a COPY of the current CDTM agreement, INCLUDING COPIES of the current patient referral and patient consent, IN THE PRIMARY PRACTICE SETTING, readily retrievable at the request of the Board of Registration in Pharmacy AND the Board of Registration in Medicine. In accordance with 243 CMR 2.12 the supervising physician must maintain the ORIGINAL of the current agreement, including the original current referral and consent, IN THE PATIENT'S MEDICAL RECORD in the custody of the supervising physician.
exam_relevance: Tests the custody split and the two-board retrievability requirement, both of which candidates commonly reduce to keeping the signed agreement somewhere.

authority.name: Massachusetts Board of Registration in Pharmacy regulations
Massachusetts Board of Registration in Medicine regulations

common_confusions: Holding the original on site and treating that as compliance
Holding the agreement without the referral and consent copies
Assuming retrievability to the Board of Registration in Pharmacy alone is enough
